idea-plugin.name: JTools
idea-plugin.description:
JTools is a powerful and lightweight plugin management container designed specifically for JetBrains IDEs. It revolutionizes the plugin development experience by providing hot-plugging capabilities, allowing developers to install, update, and uninstall plugins without restarting the IDE.
📖 Documentation | 🐛 Report Issues | 📦 Releases

✨ Key Features

  • 🔌 Hot-Plugging Support: Install and uninstall plugins on-the-fly without IDE restart, significantly improving development efficiency.
  • 📦 Drag & Drop Installation: Simply drag plugin files into the panel for instant installation, with right-click context menu for easy uninstallation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Language Development: Full support for Java, Kotlin, and JavaScript plugin development with rapid debugging capabilities.
  • 📂 Customizable Storage: Configure your preferred plugin installation directory with automatic isolation by JetBrains product and version.
  • 📋 Integrated Logging: Built-in logging console with soft-wrap output for easy troubleshooting during development and runtime.
  • 🔧 Dynamic SDK Management: Automatic SDK dependency resolution for IDEA, Maven, and Gradle projects.
  • 🌐 Web Integration: JavaScript plugins enable flexible web page integration with custom development options.
  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Open multiple instances of the same plugin simultaneously with proper resource management.
  • 📐 Split Panel View: Support for left-right panel splitting for better workspace organization.
  • 🎯 JetBrains Family Support: Compatible with the entire JetBrains IDE family including IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, and more.

🎯 Use Cases

  • Rapid prototyping and testing of IntelliJ plugins
  • Creating lightweight utility tools without full plugin overhead
  • Developing custom web-based tools integrated into the IDE
  • Building team-specific development tools with easy distribution

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Install JTools from the JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open the JTools panel from the right sidebar
  3. Drag and drop your plugin files or use the built-in development tools
  4. Start developing with hot-reload support!
📖 帮助文档 | 🐛 问题反馈 | 📦 版本发布

🛠️ JTools - 轻量级插件容器

JTools 是一个专为 JetBrains IDE 设计的强大且轻量级的插件管理容器。它通过提供热插拔功能彻底改变了插件开发体验，允许开发者在不重启 IDE 的情况下安装、更新和卸载插件。

✨ 核心特性

  • 🔌 热插拔支持：无需重启 IDE 即可即时安装和卸载插件，显著提升开发效率。
  • 📦 拖拽安装：只需将插件文件拖入面板即可立即安装，右键菜单轻松卸载。
  • 🚀 多语言开发：全面支持 Java、Kotlin 和 JavaScript 插件开发，具备快速调试能力。
  • 📂 自定义存储：可配置首选的插件安装目录，按 JetBrains 产品和版本自动隔离。
  • 📋 集成日志：内置日志控制台，支持软换行输出，便于开发和运行时故障排查。
  • 🔧 动态 SDK 管理：自动解析 IDEA、Maven 和 Gradle 项目的 SDK 依赖。
  • 🌐 Web 集成：JavaScript 插件支持灵活的网页集成和自定义开发。
  • 🪟 多实例支持：支持同时打开同一插件的多个实例，并具备完善的资源管理。
  • 📐 分割面板视图：支持左右面板分割，更好地组织工作空间。
  • 🎯 JetBrains 全家桶支持：兼容整个 JetBrains IDE 系列，包括 IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm 等。

🎯 应用场景

  • IntelliJ 插件的快速原型开发和测试
  • 创建轻量级实用工具，无需完整插件开销
  • 开发集成到 IDE 中的自定义 Web 工具
  • 构建团队专用开发工具，便于分发

🚀 快速开始

  1. 从 JetBrains Marketplace 安装 JTools
  2. 从右侧边栏打开 JTools 面板
  3. 拖放插件文件或使用内置开发工具
  4. 开始享受热重载开发体验！
idea-plugin.change-notes:
📦 Version v1.1.2.5

Latest Release / 最新版本

  • 🧩 Split Enhancements: Added split-right/split-down and move-to-split workflows aligned with IDE behavior
  • 🧩 分屏增强：新增向右/向下分屏及分屏并移动的操作流程，与 IDE 行为保持一致
  • 🖱️ Drag & Drop UX: Improved intra-split reorder and cross-split drag preview/highlight
  • 🖱️ 拖拽体验：优化同分屏排序与跨分屏拖拽预览/高亮效果
  • 🧱 Stability: Fixed content loss and gray-area issues during split drag operations
  • 🧱 稳定性：修复分屏拖拽过程中内容丢失与灰色区域问题

📦 Version v1.1.2.3

  • 🪟 Dialog Refactoring: Removed DialogWrapper support, now using JFrame for improved stability and compatibility
  • 🪟 弹窗重构：移除 DialogWrapper 支持，改用 JFrame 实现，提升弹窗稳定性和兼容性
  • 🌐 JS Plugin SDK: Added JTools SDK auto-injection for JS plugins, providing simplified API calls like JTools.help(), JTools.log.info(), etc.
  • 🌐 JS 插件 SDK：JS 插件新增 JTools SDK 自动注入，提供简化的 API 调用，如 JTools.help()、JTools.log.info() 等
  • 📁 Relative Path Support: JS plugins now support standard relative path for static resources (css/js/images), no protocol prefix required
  • 📁 相对路径支持：JS 插件现支持标准相对路径加载静态资源（css/js/图片），无需协议前缀
  • 📚 API Documentation: Added help() function to get complete JS plugin API documentation in JSON or Markdown format
  • 📚 API 文档：新增 help() 函数获取完整的 JS 插件 API 文档，支持 JSON 和 Markdown 格式
  • 🔧 New JS APIs: Added 50+ APIs including file operations, clipboard, dialogs, system commands, notifications, and cache management
  • 🔧 新增 JS API：新增 50+ 个 API，包括文件操作、剪贴板、对话框、系统命令、通知、缓存管理等
  • 💾 Cache Enhancement: Added getOrDefault, keys, exists, size, setAll methods for both global and project cache
  • 💾 缓存增强：全局缓存和项目缓存新增 getOrDefault、keys、exists、size、setAll 方法
  • 📝 Type Definitions: Added "Generate Type Definitions" action to export jtools-sdk.d.ts for IDE code completion support
  • 📝 类型定义：新增"生成类型定义"功能，导出 jtools-sdk.d.ts 文件，支持 IDE 代码提示

📦 Version v1.1.2.2

  • 🎉 IDE Compatibility: Full support for IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3 and related JetBrains products
  • 🎉 IDE 兼容性：全面支持 IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3 及相关 JetBrains 产品

📦 Version v1.1.2.1

  • 📂 Storage Isolation: Plugin storage directory now automatically isolates by JetBrains product type and version, preventing conflicts between different IDE installations
  • 📂 存储隔离：插件存储目录现在按 JetBrains 产品类型和版本自动隔离，防止不同 IDE 安装之间的冲突
  • 🔧 SDK Enhancement: Added new support functions providing JTools version and JetBrains product information, enabling plugins to target specific JetBrains products
  • 🔧 SDK 增强：新增支持函数，提供 JTools 版本和 JetBrains 产品信息，使插件能够针对特定 JetBrains 产品进行适配

📦 Version v1.1.1

  • 🎉 IDE Compatibility: Full compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2 and above
  • 🎉 IDE 兼容性：全面兼容 IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2 及以上版本

📦 Version v1.1.0

  • 🪟 Multi-Instance SDK: SDK fully adapted for multi-instance plugin support, enabling better resource management across multiple plugin windows
  • 🪟 多实例 SDK：SDK 完全适配多实例插件支持，实现多个插件窗口间更好的资源管理

📦 Version v1.0.9

  • 🎯 JetBrains Family: Extended support to the entire JetBrains IDE family including WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, PhpStorm, and more
  • 🎯 JetBrains 全家桶：扩展支持整个 JetBrains IDE 系列，包括 WebStorm、PyCharm、GoLand、PhpStorm 等

📦 Version v1.0.8

  • 📐 Split Panel: Plugin panel now supports split view functionality (currently left-right split only) for better workspace organization
  • 📐 分割面板：插件面板现支持分割视图功能（目前仅支持左右分割），更好地组织工作空间
  • 📋 Log Console: Added enable/disable toggle for the logging console to reduce resource usage when not needed
  • 📋 日志控制台：新增日志控制台启用/禁用开关，在不需要时减少资源占用

📦 Version v1.0.7

  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Plugins can now support multiple simultaneous instances by overriding the supportMultiOpens function
  • 🪟 多实例支持：插件现可通过重载 supportMultiOpens 函数支持同时打开多个实例
  • 🔄 Panel Refactoring: Refactored showPanel and closePanel functions with new JComponent parameter for proper resource cleanup in multi-instance scenarios
  • 🔄 面板重构：重构 showPanel 和 closePanel 函数，新增 JComponent 参数，解决多实例场景下的资源回收问题
  • 🐛 Bug Fix: Fixed incorrect logger parameter in openProject callback when using drag-and-drop installation
  • 🐛 Bug 修复：修复拖动安装时 openProject 回调中 logger 参数错误的问题
  • ✨ Project Close Handler: Added automatic closePanel invocation when project is closed for opened panels
  • ✨ 项目关闭处理：新增项目关闭时自动调用已打开面板的 closePanel 函数

📦 Version v1.0.6

  • 📝 JS Templates: Added project templates for JavaScript plugin development, enabling quick demo code creation
  • 📝 JS 模板：JS 插件开发新增项目模板，可通过模板快速创建示例代码
  • 📦 JS Packaging: New packaging feature for JS plugins to create installable plugin packages from current project
  • 📦 JS 打包：JS 插件开发新增打包功能，可将当前项目打包成可安装的插件
  • 🔧 Native Development: Optimized native plugin development workflow, reducing complexity and learning curve
  • 🔧 原生开发：优化原生插件开发运行逻辑，降低开发难度和学习曲线
